buyer_job_to_be_done: What are other organisations actually doing?
who_historically_pays: Members pay for a repeating room OR sponsors pay to sit in it
verified_analogue: Vistage UK Emerging Leaders £3600/year (verified); iVentiv members free / sponsors pay (fees unpublished); Insight222 100+ orgs buyer-paid (fee unpublished)
can_four_corners_sell_this_in_year_1: Yes as a panel; weak as a standalone P&L at Head-of-L&D prices
independence_risk: Low if members only; High if sponsor in room

buyer_job_to_be_done: Am I about to spend this £250k correctly?
who_historically_pays: Buyer organisation pays at the moment of a live decision
verified_analogue: Fosway structured project engagement (price unpublished); Gartner Consulting $552.5m of $6.50bn in 2025 (8.5%); RedThread Professional $800/year + Enterprise advisory (contact)
can_four_corners_sell_this_in_year_1: Yes as project fees if you can find people in a live buy
independence_risk: Low if Four Corners does not take supplier money on that file

buyer_job_to_be_done: Who is genuinely good / who should be on the shortlist?
who_historically_pays: Buyers pay for independence; vendors also pay for briefings and positioning
verified_analogue: Fosway 9-Grid + Vendor Programme (corporate and vendor both pay; prices unpublished); Gartner sells Insights to users AND providers; Bersin corporate membership 'starts around $50,000' (Josh Bersin LinkedIn Oct 2024) plus separate vendor membership
can_four_corners_sell_this_in_year_1: Not as a 9-Grid. Possible as a narrow leadership-programme shortlist once 20+ cases exist
independence_risk: High if vendors fund the shortlist; Low if buyer pays

buyer_job_to_be_done: What happened after we bought / ran it?
who_historically_pays: Rarely paid as a standalone product. Usually vendor case studies (biased) or multi-year research memberships
verified_analogue: Towards Maturity / Learning Health Check: free benchmark that took ~11 years as a CIC then was absorbed into Emerald Works (2020); RedThread research library inside membership
can_four_corners_sell_this_in_year_1: Capture from day 1; do not sell as a 200-interview product until you have ~30 written cases
independence_risk: Medium if vendors commission 'independent' case studies

buyer_job_to_be_done: Introductions / time with people who control spend
who_historically_pays: Suppliers pay. Guests usually attend free.
verified_analogue: Gordon Glenister executive dinner £10,000+VAT for 10-12 guests (verified list price); HR Insight Forum hosted 15 HR Directors for a partner (testimonial; price unpublished); iVentiv: HEC Paris 88 events since 2010 and 'won significant contracts'; HU-X quote 'that's all business from iVentiv'
can_four_corners_sell_this_in_year_1: Yes immediately. This is a different company from independent intelligence
independence_risk: Structural: guests know they were recruited for the sponsor

buyer_job_to_be_done: Buy and administer courses at scale
who_historically_pays: Client fees and/or supplier margin on volume
verified_analogue: Premier Partnership 800+ partners / 400k learners claimed; Now Training vendor-neutral MLS since 1997
can_four_corners_sell_this_in_year_1: No. Operationally a different firm. Kill for Four Corners year 1-3
